How to do it: Wash or air it, steam out creases, use a lint roller, empty the pockets, do up buttons and zips.
Check before you move on: No creases, hairs or fluff you can see on the phone screen.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Jacket steamed, lint rolled, all buttons done up

How to do it: Shoot by a window in daylight. No direct sun, no flash. Turn off ceiling lights so the colours do not mix.
Check before you move on: White parts look white, not yellow or blue.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Next to a big window in the late morning, ceiling light off

How to do it: A plain, light background: a white sheet, a white wall or a light grey board. Nothing else in the photo.
Check before you move on: No furniture, pets, feet or mess in the frame.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): White bedsheet on the floor, pulled flat

How to do it: Pick one style and use it for every photo: flat lay (laid on the floor, shot from above), on a hanger against a plain wall, or worn.
Check before you move on: Same style, same background in all main shots.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Flat lay for shots 1 to 7, worn for shot 8

How to do it: Wipe the lens. Use the normal 1x lens, no digital zoom. Turn on the grid. Tap the item to focus. Turn off beauty and portrait filters.
Check before you move on: Photo is sharp when you zoom in on the screen.

How to do it: Fill most of the frame with the whole item. Hold the phone level, straight above or straight in front.
Check before you move on: Edges of the item are not cut off. Item is straight, not at an angle.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Whole jacket laid flat, front view, sleeves straight at the sides

How to do it: Same distance and angle as shot 1, item turned over.
Check before you move on: Looks like shot 1, from the other side.

How to do it: Close-up of the brand label, flat and in focus. Fill the frame with the label.
Check before you move on: Every letter on the label can be read.

How to do it: Close-up of the size label and the fabric and care label. Unfold it so the text is flat.
Check before you move on: Size and fabric numbers can be read.

How to do it: Get close to show the texture and true colour. Daylight only.
Check before you move on: Colour on screen matches the item in your hand.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Close-up of the denim weave at the chest pocket

How to do it: Buttons, zips, pockets, prints, stitching or hardware buyers ask about.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Close-up of the metal buttons and chest pocket flap

How to do it: One photo per flaw, even small ones. Point to it with a finger or a pen so buyers see where it is.
Check before you move on: Every flaw you will write in the description has a photo.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Light fading on the left cuff, pen pointing to it

How to do it: Tape measure across the item laid flat (pit to pit for tops, waist for bottoms), or a worn photo to show the fit.
Check before you move on: Numbers on the tape can be read.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Tape pit to pit showing 58 cm

How to do it: Zoom in on each photo on your phone. Retake any that are blurry, dark or at an angle.
Check before you move on: No blurry or dark photos left.

How to do it: Crop and straighten. Brighten a little if it is dark. No filters, no colour changes, no text, logos or borders on the photo.
Check before you move on: Colour still matches the real item.

How to do it: Shot 1 first, because it is the photo buyers see in search and the feed. Then follow the order above.
Check before you move on: First photo is the whole item, front.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Order: front, back, labels, fabric, details, flaw, tape

How to do it: Check the photo limit and the shape the app shows. Put the most useful shots first if the app gives you only a few slots.
Check before you move on: All key shots fit in the slots you have.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Vinted: all 8 shots. Depop: shots 1, 3, 7, 8 plus a short video
